title: The best concert of the year
situation: Last weekend you went to a concert with some friends. You write a blog in English about music and the things you do in your free time. Write a post about the concert.
situationHu: A hétvégén koncerten voltál a barátaiddal; írj róla bejegyzést az angol nyelvű blogodba.

points.text: say who played and where the concert was
describe the best moment of the evening
say whether you would recommend this band or singer and why

usefulPhrases.en: Last Saturday I went to see … live.
The concert was held at … in …

usefulPhrases.hu: A legjobb pillanat az volt, amikor …

usefulPhrases.en: Have you ever seen them live?
